meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Hail Mary
meta.description: I am a Doll that makes the impossible possible.

units.rawText: Backup data recovery 99% complete.
units.displayText: Backup data recovery 99% complete.

spans.text: Backup data recovery 99% complete.

units.rawText: In the Ops Room of Titan Base.
units.displayText: In the Ops Room of Titan Base.

spans.text: In the Ops Room of Titan Base.

units.rawText: Hailing Agent S901!
units.displayText: Hailing Agent S901!

spans.text: Hailing Agent S901!

units.rawText: Ptolemy Data Center Agent S901 is not responding to communications request.
units.displayText: Ptolemy Data Center Agent S901 is not responding to communications request.

spans.text: Ptolemy Data Center Agent S901 is not responding to communications request.

units.rawText: Send again.
units.displayText: Send again.

spans.text: Send again.

units.rawText: Ptolemy Data Center Agent S901 is not responding to communications request.
units.displayText: Ptolemy Data Center Agent S901 is not responding to communications request.

spans.text: Ptolemy Data Center Agent S901 is not responding to communications request.

units.rawText: Again.
units.displayText: Again.

spans.text: Again.

units.rawText: Not responding...
units.displayText: Not responding...

spans.text: Not responding...

units.rawText: Dammit.
units.displayText: Dammit.

spans.text: Dammit.

units.rawText: Yuwang grits his teeth before sending an order to the system.
units.displayText: Yuwang grits his teeth before sending an order to the system.

spans.text: Yuwang grits his teeth before sending an order to the system.

units.rawText: Shut down all operand barriers that are not protecting the Ptolemy Data Center or the Millennium Pegasus.
units.displayText: Shut down all operand barriers that are not protecting the Ptolemy Data Center or the Millennium Pegasus.

spans.text: Shut down all operand barriers that are not protecting the Ptolemy Data Center or the Millennium Pegasus.

units.rawText: Divert all operands to weapons systems and target the entropics outside the Data Center. Fire!
units.displayText: Divert all operands to weapons systems and target the entropics outside the Data Center. Fire!

spans.text: Divert all operands to weapons systems and target the entropics outside the Data Center. Fire!

units.rawText: Understood. Contracting defense barrier. Contraction process 20% complete. Now restoring breaches in internal barrier...
units.displayText: Understood. Contracting defense barrier. Contraction process 20% complete. Now restoring breaches in internal barrier...

spans.text: Understood. Contracting defense barrier. Contraction process 20% complete. Now restoring breaches in internal barrier...

units.rawText: The moment the defense barrier pulls back, the entropics surge forward like a horde of locusts. All the guns on the base open fire and barely managed to stem the tide with sheer volume of bullets.
units.displayText: The moment the defense barrier pulls back, the entropics surge forward like a horde of locusts. All the guns on the base open fire and barely managed to stem the tide with sheer volume of bullets.

spans.text: The moment the defense barrier pulls back, the entropics surge forward like a horde of locusts. All the guns on the base open fire and barely managed to stem the tide with sheer volume of bullets.

units.rawText: If I abandon the other areas, I'll be able to buy Xinghuan more time. But...
units.displayText: If I abandon the other areas, I'll be able to buy Xinghuan more time. But...

spans.text: If I abandon the other areas, I'll be able to buy Xinghuan more time. But...

units.rawText: Yuwang looks at his screen. Outside the base, a high-energy operand contact is drawing closer and closer.
units.displayText: Yuwang looks at his screen. Outside the base, a high-energy operand contact is drawing closer and closer.

spans.text: Yuwang looks at his screen. Outside the base, a high-energy operand contact is drawing closer and closer.

units.rawText: The High Order Entropic... is here.
units.displayText: The High Order Entropic... is here.

spans.text: The High Order Entropic... is here.

units.rawText: As though he's making up his mind, Yuwang grits his teeth, then he quickly enters a command on the keyboard.
units.displayText: As though he's making up his mind, Yuwang grits his teeth, then he quickly enters a command on the keyboard.

spans.text: As though he's making up his mind, Yuwang grits his teeth, then he quickly enters a command on the keyboard.

units.rawText: Transferring all command permissions to the Ops Room.
units.displayText: Transferring all command permissions to the Ops Room.

spans.text: Transferring all command permissions to the Ops Room.

units.rawText: Command received. Switching to automatic operation mode.
units.displayText: Command received. Switching to automatic operation mode.

spans.text: Command received. Switching to automatic operation mode.

units.rawText: Send the following text message to the sector administrator Xuannu: "Data transfer mission in Saturnian system complete except for Titan. Xinghuan is handling the rest in person."
units.displayText: Send the following text message to the sector administrator Xuannu: "Data transfer mission in Saturnian system complete except for Titan. Xinghuan is handling the rest in person."

spans.text: Send the following text message to the sector administrator Xuannu: "Data transfer mission in Saturnian system complete except for Titan. Xinghuan is handling the rest in person."

units.rawText: Send the following text message to the taikonaut Xinghuan: "There's a ship and escape pod in the hangar elevator."
units.displayText: Send the following text message to the taikonaut Xinghuan: "There's a ship and escape pod in the hangar elevator."

spans.text: Send the following text message to the taikonaut Xinghuan: "There's a ship and escape pod in the hangar elevator."

units.rawText: Messages sent.
units.displayText: Messages sent.

spans.text: Messages sent.

units.rawText: The rest is up to you, Xinghuan...
units.displayText: The rest is up to you, Xinghuan...

spans.text: The rest is up to you, Xinghuan...

units.rawText: Yuwang sighs and places a hand on his core. He can feel a faint heat rising through his fingers.
units.displayText: Yuwang sighs and places a hand on his core. He can feel a faint heat rising through his fingers.

spans.text: Yuwang sighs and places a hand on his core. He can feel a faint heat rising through his fingers.

units.rawText: I have trouble moving and I don't have any powerful weapons. The only thing I have that might pose a threat is my core. But how powerful will detonating my core be?
units.displayText: I have trouble moving and I don't have any powerful weapons. The only thing I have that might pose a threat is my core. But how powerful will detonating my core be?

spans.text: I have trouble moving and I don't have any powerful weapons. The only thing I have that might pose a threat is my core. But how powerful will detonating my core be?

units.rawText: If I could go all the way inside the Entropic Horde and trigger it while carrying the base's supply of flammables...
units.displayText: If I could go all the way inside the Entropic Horde and trigger it while carrying the base's supply of flammables...

spans.text: If I could go all the way inside the Entropic Horde and trigger it while carrying the base's supply of flammables...

units.rawText: Yuwang rushes out of the Ops Room, toward the target he's set his sights on for a while.
units.displayText: Yuwang rushes out of the Ops Room, toward the target he's set his sights on for a while.

spans.text: Yuwang rushes out of the Ops Room, toward the target he's set his sights on for a while.

units.rawText: Grah—
units.displayText: Grah—

spans.text: Grah—

units.rawText: The sound of his racing wheelchair echoes through the base. The entropics soon noticed the sound and warily look in its direction.
units.displayText: The sound of his racing wheelchair echoes through the base. The entropics soon noticed the sound and warily look in its direction.

spans.text: The sound of his racing wheelchair echoes through the base. The entropics soon noticed the sound and warily look in its direction.

units.rawText: Return in triumph, glory to...
units.displayText: Return in triumph, glory to...

spans.text: Return in triumph, glory to...

units.rawText: <size=40>HELLBORE CANNON, FIRE!</size>
units.displayText: HELLBORE CANNON, FIRE!

spans.text: HELLBORE CANNON, FIRE!

units.rawText: <size=40>KABOOM!!!!</size>
units.displayText: KABOOM!!!!

spans.text: KABOOM!!!!

units.rawText: A deafening explosion and the massive shockwave from the cannon stop Yuwang in his tracks.
units.displayText: A deafening explosion and the massive shockwave from the cannon stop Yuwang in his tracks.

spans.text: A deafening explosion and the massive shockwave from the cannon stop Yuwang in his tracks.

units.rawText: As the dark purple smoke clears, the steely form in the air comes into view, and Xinghuan smiles confidently at him from the piloting cradle.
units.displayText: As the dark purple smoke clears, the steely form in the air comes into view, and Xinghuan smiles confidently at him from the piloting cradle.

spans.text: As the dark purple smoke clears, the steely form in the air comes into view, and Xinghuan smiles confidently at him from the piloting cradle.

units.rawText: Sorry, you know how heroes are always fashionably late and all...
units.displayText: Sorry, you know how heroes are always fashionably late and all...

spans.text: Sorry, you know how heroes are always fashionably late and all...
